comments.body:
Correction to the preceding metadata note (2026-09-03)

The v8.1.3 source comment on `SerializationOptions.with_meta` is not matched by serialized behavior. An isolated import probe against the exact `python-hcl2==8.1.3` wheel parsed:

`variable "x" {\n  type = string\n}`

Observed:
- `loads(..., serialization_options=SerializationOptions(with_meta=True))` returned block data with `__is_block__` but no `__start_line__`/`__end_line__`.
- Public `parses_to_tree(...)` returned raw Lark nodes whose `Tree.meta` ranges were block `1:1–3:2` and attribute `2:2–2:15`.

The revised plan therefore uses `hcl2.parses_to_tree` plus public Lark `Tree.meta` and explicitly forbids reliance on serialized metadata. This note supersedes the prior claim that `with_meta=True` emits the line keys. Source: https://github.com/amplify-education/python-hcl2/blob/v8.1.3/hcl2/api.py

Pinned API evidence addendum (2026-09-03)

The exact v8.1.3 public and positional preconditions are:
- `hcl2.api.parses_to_tree(text: str) -> Tree` (distinct from `parse_to_tree(file: TextIO)`) and it is exported by `hcl2.__init__`.
- `hcl2.parser.parser()` constructs Lark with `propagate_positions=True`.
- An isolated exact-wheel invocation of `parses_to_tree` observed `Tree.meta` coordinates block `1:1–3:2`, attribute `2:2–2:15`.

compiled_state.description:
## Context

Purpose: conservative module-wide Terraform evidence for T10 Pass 1 and independent Pass 2.

## Scope

### Optional boundary

Add `grounding-terraform = ["python-hcl2==8.1.3"]` and the `hcl2` probe. In `_capabilities.py`, add `grounding-terraform` to `DECLARED_EXTRAS` and register ABSTAIN-posture `grounding_terraform`. It is sole opt-in; core/non-Terraform paths import/advertise nothing. Extend optionality CI.

### Structural index

Add `terraform_index.py`/`terraform_tools.py`. Each call owns cache+ledger; its finalizer frees them. Pass 2 re-captures the frozen source; no cache crosses steps.

- Trigger on impacted `.tf`/`.tf.json`, or Terraform/OpenTofu plan plus repo Terraform. Index affected directories; follow repo-contained literal children/reverse callers; exclude VCS, virtualenv, `.terraform/`.
- Directly inspect a changed `.tfvars`, but never infer it is selected.
- Reject absolute/out-of-repo sources and escaping symlinks. Enforce 64 modules, 5,000 files, 32 MiB, and the existing 60-second deadline before returning facts; any failure yields one abstention with no partial facts.
- Exact-wheel import probe exited 0: `8.1.3`; `parses_to_tree` signature `(text: str) -> lark.tree.Tree`; `parser().options.propagate_positions=True`; `Tree.meta` block `(1,1,3,2)`, attribute `(2,2,2,15)`; serialized meta keys `['__is_block__']`. Use `parses_to_tree` on strict-UTF-8-decoded bytes; JSON uses unambiguous key range, else file-level. Full command/output: ticket evidence comment dated 2026-09-03.

### Operations and schemas

- `lookup_declaration(address, module_path="")`: variable, local, output, module, provider, managed resource, data resource.
- `resolve_reference(reference, from_file)`: direct module traversals/repo-local child outputs; resource bases may resolve, provider attributes never do.
- Both are `job=refute`: static resolution returns `refuted` at T1; all non-proof is `abstain`; neither emits `match` or asserts absence.
- Grounding references use `kind="symbol"` for declarations and `kind="member"` for dotted traversals, with canonical address as `name` and `language="terraform"`. Closed `terraform_kind`: `variable|local|output|module|provider|managed_resource|data_resource`.
- Normalize paths to NFC repo-relative POSIX (empty module `.`; collapse dots; preserve case; reject NUL/absolute/escaping `..`). Trim outer address whitespace, grammar-parse, and case-preserving dot-render; internal whitespace, splats, or computed indexes abstain.

Add closed `terraform_grounding_receipt.schema.json`; validate evidence against `grounding.schema.json` and receipts against it. Required receipt fields: `schema_version`, `operation`, normalized `query`, `snapshot_digest`, `module_digest`, `backend` (parser/version, analyzer/version, config digest), `limits`, `outcome`, generic `reason`, closed `reason_detail`, and `result_digest`. Snapshot/module SHA-256 uses a sorted length-prefixed path+byte stream. Config/result reuse `"sha256:" + rebar._store.canonical.content_hash(float_free_object)`. Refuted hashes safe facts; abstain hashes exactly `{outcome,reason,reason_detail}`.

Worked receipt (digests abbreviated only here):

`{"schema_version":1,"operation":"lookup_declaration","query":{"address":"module.web","module":"infra"},"snapshot_digest":"sha256:…","module_digest":"sha256:…","backend":{"parser":"python-hcl2","parser_version":"8.1.3","analyzer":"rebar-terraform-structural","analyzer_version":1,"config_digest":"sha256:…"},"limits":{"modules":64,"files":5000,"bytes":33554432,"timeout_ms":60000},"outcome":"refuted","reason":null,"reason_detail":null,"result_digest":"sha256:…"}`

Worked abstain (same required provenance): `{"operation":"resolve_reference","query":{"reference":"aws_instance.web.id","from_file":"infra/main.tf"},"outcome":"abstain","reason":"ambiguous","reason_detail":"provider_attribute","result_digest":"sha256:…"}`.

Exact abstention translation:

- Missing extra → `no_tool/missing_extra`; wrong parser version → `version_skew/parser_version`; non-Terraform call → `unsupported_lang/not_terraform`.
- Pre-worker invalid/undecodable input → `parse_error/invalid_input`; unreadable capture → `parse_error/unreadable_file`.
- Harness `timeout` → `timeout/worker_timeout`; harness `parse_error` (including indistinguishable native signal death) → `parse_error/invalid_input`; harness `other` from raise/no-result/protocol failure → `other/worker_failure`.
- Duplicate address → `ambiguous/duplicate_address`; no unique hit → `ambiguous/no_unique_address`; dynamic source/expression → `ambiguous/dynamic_source|dynamic_expression`; computed value → `ambiguous/computed_value`; provider attribute → `ambiguous/provider_attribute`; splat/index → `ambiguous/splat_index`; unknown tfvars selection → `ambiguous/unknown_tfvars`.
- Absolute/out-of-repo/escaping symlink → `private_or_internal_suspected/path_outside_snapshot`.
- Module/file/byte bound → `other/module_limit|file_limit|byte_limit`.

Return only safe classes, hashes, and repo-relative locations—never credentials or literal payloads.

### Plan-review integration

Inject tools only into Terraform T10 Pass 1. Terraform evidence selects Pass 2 with a fresh ledger and required independent query; inject no Pass-1 answer. Add a per-call tool provider/finalizer to `RunnerAgentStep`, preserving static `extra_tools`.

Record concrete reads as synthetic `read_file` usage and signed `**/*.tf`/`**/*.tf.json` membership, so sibling additions alter stdlib-only freshness. Missing extra exposes no tools; failures abstain.

## Positive rationale

Reuse existing seams; never scan or evaluate Terraform.

## Out of scope

Registry/remote content, prompts, scanners, `terraform-config-inspect`, and Terraform/OpenTofu/provider execution.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Lean-install tests pin `python-hcl2==8.1.3`; absent-extra/non-Terraform routes import/advertise nothing.
- [x] Index tests find sibling files, bounded child/reverse callers, and keep targeted `.tfvars` unselected.
- [x] `lookup_declaration` tests assert exact `symbol`/`terraform_kind`, T1 `refuted`, line range, safe facts, and receipt.
- [x] `resolve_reference` tests assert exact `member` mapping and child-output resolution; computed/provider/dynamic controls abstain.
- [x] Boundary tests assert exact reasons/digests, no partial facts, cache/ledger retirement, worker reaping, and below/at/above bounds.
- [x] Workflow integration captures T10 Pass-1/Pass-2 requests with distinct ledgers; non-T10/non-Terraform controls expose no tool.
- [x] Signed-read-set tests observe all parsed files/patterns, then add a sibling `.tf` and observe freshness change.
- [x] `tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_tools.py::test_no_forbidden_executables` observes no Terraform, OpenTofu, provider, tfparse, TFLint, Trivy, terraform-ls, terraform-docs, or other executable.
- [x] Schema tests validate evidence/receipts; `docs/grounding.md` and ADR 0115 document tools, trust boundary, outcomes/reasons, posture, limits, lifecycle, and prohibitions.

## Testing

Test contract card:

- Contract: REB-640, `docs/grounding.md`, ADR 0115, both schemas, harness `RunResult`.
- Preconditions: sibling/child/reverse, dynamic, escape, bound, and harness fixtures.
- Production: real capture/worker/response/request; fake only the model.
- Tiers: parser/evidence unit-contract; workflow integration; lean-install subprocess.
- Oracles: exact evidence/receipt/tools; no partial facts; cleanup; membership-digest change.
- Controls: non-Terraform has no tools; literal resolves, computed abstains.
- CI: `make test`, `make docs-check`, and optionality CI.

## Verification

`env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_index.py tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_tools.py tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py tests/unit/test_capabilities.py && env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make docs-check`
